subject: summary of issues in BUGS examples

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: summary of issues in BUGS examples
parts:
Now in BUGS example folder, if the model could not be run in 
Stan, I use stan.0 as the file suffix.  In vol3, we have more models 
not supported.  I have not figure out what the model is in some of 
vol3 examples.  Or because of the discrete parameters in the models, 
it is not even tried to implement --- for example, an example is 
using the truncated stick-break process to approximate Dirichet process
model, which, I think,  essentially change the problem from non-parametric Bayes
model to parametric model.   

Main issues in implemented (or not) bugs examples are: 

$ find . |grep stan.0

./vol3/fire/fire.stan.0
./vol2/schools/schools.stan.0
--- it takes NUTS too long to adapt / sample. 

./vol3/funshapes/hsquare.stan.0
./vol3/funshapes/ring.stan.0
./vol3/funshapes/squaremc.stan.0
--- the sampler hangs. 

./vol3/jama/jama.stan.0
./vol2/ice/vanilla_ice.stan.0
./vol2/ice/pineapple_ice.stan.0
--- we could not specify the joint posterior as BUGS 
specifies the model with circles in terms of DAG, which is 
not supported by JAGS either.  (Note that JAGS does not 
support all functionality of OpenBUGS). 

./vol2/asia/asia.stan.0
./vol2/t_df/estdof2.stan.0
./vol2/biopsies/biopsies.stan.0
./vol2/stagnant/stagnant.stan.0
--- discrete parameters, for example, categorical distribution. 
Some of them are not implemented at all. 

./vol2/hearts/hearts.stan.0
./vol2/cervix/cervix.stan.0
-- discrete parameters: binary distributed parameters, in other versions for 
the same model that working, discrete parameters are integrated out. 

./vol1/bones/bones.stan.0
--- it is fine for stan to draw samples, but the data structure is a 
bit difficult to deal with.  I will see if I can figure it out later. 

./vol1/leuk/leuk.stan.0
./vol1/leukfr/leukfr.stan.0
-- we have 0 ~ Poisson(0 * parameters), which seems to 
cause the sampler hang. 


--
Jiqiang
